同样是中英翻译，学校材料、产品介绍、会议陪同和法院口译，需要的准备可能完全不同。: Chinese-English translation can mean very different preparation for school documents, product descriptions, meeting support, or court interpreting. Explaining who will use it, how, and by when is more helpful than starting with a per-page price. This article helps you organize your needs and compare deliverables; the receiving organization must confirm whether it accepts the materials.
笔译交付文字，需要说明原文语言、目标语言、简体或繁体、文件类型和可编辑程度。口译: Written translation produces text: specify the source and target languages, Simplified or Traditional Chinese, file type, and editability. Interpreting supports live communication: specify the exact language, such as Mandarin or Cantonese, online or in-person format, location, time zone, participant count, and communication setup. Explain before requesting a quote whether simultaneous interpreting or presentation materials are involved. Speaking two languages does not automatically qualify someone for every specialized setting.
向接收方要一份明确要求: Get clear requirements from the recipient
联系学校、法院或其他接收机构，询问其接受的语言、译者资格或声明、签字形式、文件格: Contact the school, court, or other receiving institution to ask about accepted languages, translator qualifications or statements, signature requirements, file formats, and any specific certification or notarization procedure. Save an official link or written reply and ask the provider to confirm they can meet it. Don't apply one institution's rules to another or assume an ad saying “certified translation” is enough.
加州法院的口译员查询页明确说明，司法委员会的法院口译认证或注册，并不代表它另行测: California Courts' interpreter directory explains that Judicial Council court interpreter certification or registration does not mean written translation skills have also been tested or certified. For court interpreting, start with the California Courts page on requesting an interpreter and confirm the process with the relevant court contact. Don't hire someone first and assume the court will accept them or cover the cost.
让报价对应可检查的交付物: Tie the quote to deliverables you can check
笔译说明页数或字数、扫描件是否清晰、是否有表格和手写内容，问清版式还原、校对、译: For written translation, state page or word count, scan quality, and any tables or handwriting. Ask whether layout recreation, proofreading, a translator's declaration, and revisions are included. For interpreting, confirm session length, minimum charges, preparation, travel, equipment, overtime, and cancellation rules. Give the actual date of use and separate deadlines for draft, review, and final delivery. Discovering missing pages near a deadline is harder than supplying them early.
询价阶段只提供必要信息: Share only what's needed for a quote
公开帖子不附完整护照、成绩单、病历或账户资料。询价先描述文件类型和工作量，必要时: Do not attach complete passports, transcripts, medical records, or account information to public posts. For quotes, describe document types and workload, and provide sample pages with irrelevant sensitive details redacted if needed. Send complete materials required for the actual translation through a restricted channel both parties have agreed on. Do not remove or alter original content that must be translated accurately.
FTC 的商家资料保护指南强调只保留必要数据、限制访问并妥善处置。把这些原则变成: The FTC's business data-protection guidance emphasizes keeping only necessary data, limiting access, and disposing of it appropriately. Turn those principles into questions: Who can see the files? Will they be passed to another translator or uploaded to third-party AI tools? How long are they kept, and what happens afterward? Agree on handling before sending complete files, rather than relying on “absolute confidentiality.”
交付时，优先核对不能错的细节: At delivery, check the details that must be right first
逐页确认是否完整，姓名拼写、日期、金额和编号是否与原文一致。: Check every page for completeness and verify names, dates, amounts, and reference numbers against the original.
确认章戳、手写内容及无法辨认处已按约定处理，没有把不确定内容猜成事实。: Confirm stamps, handwriting, and illegible sections were handled as agreed, without turning uncertain content into guessed facts.
对照接收机构要求检查格式、签字或附加文件，保存最终版本与原文对应关系。: Check formatting, signatures, and additional documents against the receiving organization's requirements. Keep the final version linked to its source text.
有疑问时标注具体页码和位置让译者复核，确认终稿后再提交给接收方。: If something is unclear, give the translator the page number and exact location to review. Confirm the final version before submitting it.
